payload.text: **THE WIDGET VOCABULARY IS CLOSED AND DECLARED, AND AN UNKNOWN WIDGET IS REFUSED BY NAME RATHER THAN SKIPPED.** The shipped set is `text`, `number`, `select`, `button` and `prose`; the vocabulary is declared in the DSL schema the way `entry_dispositions` and `target_states` are declared in the register, and a value outside it is a load-time refusal. **`prose` IS NOT AN INLINE MULTI-LINE WIDGET -- it is a HANDOFF to the external editor** (`AC-17.10`), which is what keeps the form a flat single-line-per-field column rather than a layout engine. **`select` on a status field offers only the legal transitions from the current state and prompts for a reason where the transition owes one** -- the machine already refuses illegal moves, and a plain dropdown would offer them and discover the refusal after the keystroke. **A skipped field renders a form that looks complete and is not**, which is the silent-partial class this thread exists to remove.
